definitions.identity: Exact original URL; latest collected date and last saved row win, without mixing captures from other dates.
definitions.eligible: Unique URLs minus explicit URL rejections and exact source-domain/publisher rejections; provisional if feedback is not applied.
definitions.classification: Valid proposal rows; shares use classifiedArticles, coverage uses eligibleArticles. Method labels are not proof of semantic review.
definitions.bodyReviewReady: Current source/policy-bound shared body review with article-summary ready; not a count of written summaries.
definitions.videoMetadataSummaries: Not measured: capture metadata status alone does not prove a video summary was written.
definitions.entities: Distinct eligible URLs from body-review-ready facts; exact NFKC/alias normalization only. Dates are selected representative collection dates.
definitions.exclusionReasons: One URL may have multiple reasons; reason counts are not additive.
definitions.time: Collection dates stop at coveredThrough; evaluation files/timestamps stop at reviewAsOf end of JST day. Naive legacy review timestamps are interpreted as UTC.
